explain.html:
Un día en Madrid1:25

No te preocupes, ya me las apañaré.

Don’t worry, I’ll manage somehow.

a·pa·ñár·se·las

/a.paˈɲaɾ.se.las/verb, reflexive

to manage on your own, somehow

Usually: to fix or patch something up (apañar)

In this scene

She’s brushing off the offer: “don’t worry, I’ll sort it out myself”. It sounds relaxed and a little proud.

“Apañárselas” means to get by with what you have. The “las” doesn’t point at anything; it’s part of the phrase.

Tips

Why here

She was just asked if she needs help, and answers with “no te preocupes” first.

Another way to say it

Ya me las arreglaré.

Same meaning, heard all over the Spanish-speaking world; “apañar” sounds more like Spain.

Other meanings

to tidy up · to dress up a little

Lines before

¿Seguro que no necesitas ayuda? Are you sure you don’t need help?
